facts.text: ThermoFisherVerios implements the SmartEM microscope interface for a Thermo Fisher scanning electron microscope and depends on the proprietary autoscript_sdb_microscope_client package
initialize creates SdbMicroscopeClient, connects to params['ip'], sets the stage RAW coordinate system and unblanks the electron beam
close calls disconnect and deletes the microscope client handle
prepare_acquisition runs auto contrast/brightness, auto focus, auto lens alignment, auto stig, auto focus and auto contrast/brightness
auto_focus sets the horizontal field width, runs the vendor autofocus (Volumescope settings when baseline is false), reads the working distance and restores the baseline focus after an exception
get_image sets the scanning resolution and horizontal field width from resolution and pixel_size, uses bit_depth 16 and returns the vendor frame data
move builds a StagePosition with x, y, z, r and t in coordinate_system 'Raw' and calls specimen.stage.absolute_move
The plotting code labels a dwell time after multiplying it by 1e9 with ns, so dwell_time is in seconds
The example imaging parameters use a 2048 x 1768 resolution and a pixel_size of 4.0e-09
acquire_grid builds a coordinate from dx and dy and calls microscope.move with x, y, z, r and t
The caller computes fov = resolution * pixel_size and passes dx = fov[0] * 0.8 and dy = fov[1] * 0.8 to acquire_grid
